events.category: Japan / current-album quartet / contemporary vocal jazz
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Gretchen Parlato's The Wise Ones on January 31, February 1, and February 2, 2027. On January 31 the sets start at 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM; on February 1 and 2 they start at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The announced quartet is Parlato on vocals, Taylor Eigsti on piano and keyboards, Alan Hampton on bass and guitar, and Mark Guiliana on drums. Blue Note Tokyo identifies the engagement with Parlato's current The Wise Ones project and notes that Hampton co-produced the album. The venue lists a ¥9,500 music charge, with some seating categories carrying additional seat charges, and says general web reservations opened August 29, 2026 at noon.

en.why_it_matters: The live argument is the quartet, not Parlato's reputation in isolation. The Wise Ones reconnects her with a long-running creative circle, and this Tokyo band puts that history into a compact working unit: Alan Hampton brings both the bass-guitar role and his co-producer relationship to the new project, Taylor Eigsti adds a deeply interactive keyboard voice, and Mark Guiliana gives Parlato the kind of elastic rhythmic partner that makes her phrasing function as part of the ensemble rather than simply on top of it. It is a current-project performance with a particularly coherent instrumental identity.
en.trip_verdict: If January 31-February 2 overlaps a Tokyo stay, actively make room for one of the six sets and let Aoyama shape that evening. Three nights create enough flexibility to fit it around rarer Tokyo anchors rather than rebuilding a Japan itinerary around a single scarce opportunity.

es.why_it_matters: El argumento en vivo está en el cuarteto, no en la reputación de Parlato por sí sola. The Wise Ones la vuelve a conectar con un círculo creativo de muchos años y esta formación en Tokio convierte esa historia en una unidad compacta de trabajo: Alan Hampton aporta tanto el eje bajo-guitarra como su relación de coproductor con el proyecto actual, Taylor Eigsti suma una voz de teclados profundamente interactiva y Mark Guiliana le da a Parlato el tipo de socio rítmico elástico que hace que su fraseo funcione dentro del ensamble y no simplemente encima de él. Es una presentación de repertorio actual con una identidad instrumental especialmente coherente.
es.trip_verdict: Si del 31 de enero al 2 de febrero coincide con una estancia en Tokio, le haría espacio activamente a uno de los seis sets y dejaría que Aoyama ordene esa noche. Tres noches dan suficiente flexibilidad para acomodarlo alrededor de anclas más raras en Tokio, sin reconstruir un viaje a Japón alrededor de una sola oportunidad escasa.
